carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the lateral aspect of the caudal peduncle, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal surface and distinct shadowing on the ventral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A grid-like pattern consisting of vertical high-luminance bands intersecting with circular spots is clearly visible on the posterior flank and caudal peduncle; the caudal fin features a sparse arrangement of high-intensity circular pixel clusters along the dorsal and ventral lobes.
